items.problem: A machine fills bags. A sample of $n = 100$ bags has mean mass $500$ g; $\sigma = 20$ g. Use $z^* = 2$. Give the 95% confidence interval for the mean mass in grams as (low, high).
items.solution_sketch: Standard error: $20/10 = 2$. Margin: $2 \cdot 2 = 4$. Interval: $500 \pm 4$, which is (496, 504).

items.problem: A sample of $n = 36$ has $\bar{x} = 120$; $\sigma = 18$. Use $z^* = 2$. Give the 95% confidence interval for $\mu$ as (low, high).
items.solution_sketch: Standard error: $18/6 = 3$. Margin: $2 \cdot 3 = 6$. Interval: $120 \pm 6$, which is (114, 126).

items.problem: A 95% confidence interval from a sample of $n = 25$, built with $z^* = 2$, is $(46, 54)$. Find the population standard deviation $\sigma$.
items.solution_sketch: Margin: half the width, $(54 - 46)/2 = 4$. Margin formula: $4 = 2 \cdot \sigma/\sqrt{25} = 2\sigma/5$. Solve: $\sigma = 10$.

items.problem: A sample of $n = 64$ has $\bar{x} = 30$; $\sigma = 4$. Use $z^* = 2$. Find the width of the 95% confidence interval for $\mu$.
items.solution_sketch: Standard error: $4/8 = 0.5$. Margin: $2 \cdot 0.5 = 1$. The interval is $(29, 31)$, so the width is $2 \cdot 1 = 2$.
